Remark
[The defining inequalities, not the vanishing-viscosity construction, are the definition] ↗ def:viscosity-solution-cauchy-problem 1. ch10:10.1-rem-2\group Viscosity Solutions

The intrinsic definition is the pair of test-function inequalities (16), (17). Vanishing viscosity is one construction that implies these inequalities, not part of the definition.
